messages:
samuel: deploy-bot just raised a canary alert for eu-1 (p95 + error spike). Auto-revert in ~4m. Should we let it run or take manual control?
deploy-bot: ALERT: eu-1 rollout p95 380ms (+160ms) and 2.2% 5xxs over 2m. Auto-revert scheduled in 4m. Use /deploybot ack to suppress.
ivy: quick check of traces: spike concentrated on new batching kernel; a handful of pods show queueing. Looks regional.
nate: If it's regional, prefer manual rollback scoped to eu-1 only. Set suppression TTL and owner first. I'll draft a short customer note for Dedicated tenants.
samuel: I'll ack suppression and own the rollback if needed. Command: ```/deploybot ack suppress --thread 1749007777 --by samuel --reason "manual investigate; scoped rollback plan" --until 2026-03-30T14:05:00Z```
deploy-bot: CONFIRMED: suppression acknowledged by samuel until 2026-03-30T14:05:00Z (id sup-5e1a). Monitoring continues.
ivy: After restart of two impacted pods p95 dropped from 380ms -> 190ms in ~45s, 5xxs down to 0.3%. That suggests a node-level flake but worth a cautious rollback if it reoccurs.
nate: I still recommend staged rollback command ready: ```/deploybot rollout set-version --region eu-1 --version v7.1.4 --traffic 20% --staged --step-duration 300s --thread 1749007777```
samuel: agreed. Hold until 5m window passes. If sustained or control-slice >1%, execute staged rollback and notify me + ops-bot.
ops-bot: NOTE: when suppressing auto-revert, owners must set TTL, an explicit rollback plan, and notify account reps for any Dedicated tenants.
ivy: telemetry now stable at canary; I'll continue to monitor and report in 5m. If it stays good, expire suppression early and post a blurb to relnotes.
samuel: thanks. If we hit rollback I'll run the staged plan and pin region for 12h post-rollback. :thumbsup:
